feather_badge.name: Feather Badge
feather_badge.description: Grants a graceful mid-air Double Jump! Great for reaching high treetops and secret ledges.
feather_badge.hint: Available in Pip's Cozy Curiosity Shop for 8 Gems.

breeze_dash.name: Breeze Dash
breeze_dash.description: Press [Shift] or [X] to dart forward on a gentle gust of wind across wide gaps.
breeze_dash.hint: Available in Pip's Cozy Curiosity Shop for 12 Gems.

clover_boots.name: Clover Boots
clover_boots.description: Increases walking speed and acceleration by ~30% for breezy meadow sprints.
clover_boots.hint: Available in Pip's Cozy Curiosity Shop for 10 Gems.

magnet_charm.name: Magnet Charm
magnet_charm.description: Softly pulls nearby gems right into your satchel as you hop past.
magnet_charm.hint: Available in Pip's Shop—or chat with Luma in the Sunken Ruins!

sparkle_trail.name: Sparkle Trail
sparkle_trail.description: Cosmetic Badge: Leaves a warm trail of golden sparkles behind your footsteps.
sparkle_trail.hint: Available in Pip's Cozy Curiosity Shop for 6 Gems.

petal_trail.name: Blossom Petal Trail
petal_trail.description: Cosmetic Badge: Scatters soft pink & sage meadow petals as you leap.
petal_trail.hint: Available in Pip's Cozy Curiosity Shop for 6 Gems.

starlight_trail.name: Starlight Trail
starlight_trail.description: Cosmetic Badge: Shimmering twilight dust trails behind you in mid-air.
starlight_trail.hint: Available in Pip's Shop—or help Bramble the Fox in Canopy Cliffs!

dewdrop_bell.name: Dewdrop Bell
dewdrop_bell.description: A tiny glass bell from the Meadow Overlook that rings softly whenever morning mist rolls in.
dewdrop_bell.hint: Hidden high above Meadow Hub—try bouncing up the mossy platforms!

mossy_compass.name: Mossy Compass
mossy_compass.description: An old brass pocket compass overgrown with clover. Its needle always points toward warm tea.
mossy_compass.hint: Tucked on the highest branch of Canopy Cliffs.

starlight_lantern.name: Starlight Lantern
starlight_lantern.description: A palm-sized lantern humming with bottled twilight from the upper Sunken Ruins.
starlight_lantern.hint: Resting on an upper stone arch in the Sunken Ruins.

fossil_acorn.name: Amber Acorn
fossil_acorn.description: A prehistoric golden acorn preserved in warm amber, prized by forest cartographers.
fossil_acorn.hint: Across the quiet subterranean pool in the Sunken Ruins.
